name: Philippine Championship 2017

venue.name: [SM City Marikina](https://www.smsupermalls.com/mall-locator/sm-city-marikina/information/)
venue.address: Marcos Highway, Brgy. Kalumpang, Marikina City

information: Registration fee is 350php for the first 3 events. Additional 50php will be implemented per extra event thereon. Payment-first basis will be implemented for competitors coming from the Philippines. Refer to the competition tabs for the payment details. Registration fee includes certificate of participation, scoresheets, Competitors IDs and the official competition lanyard.
